text:
leah_sales: Quick sync: Interchange POC kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. Customer wants a drop-in replacement for Competitor Z's API. Priority: response shape parity (status codes + error payloads), header mapping (x-request-id), streaming behavior, and a pricing mock that mirrors their per-request billing for evaluation. Can @mike_se lead the tech side?

mike_se: Yep. Need three things from the customer to scope: example API calls (incl. streaming logs), expected SLA (p95 latency), and their current tokenization policy. Also: do they expect exact token counts for billing parity or just approximate mapping?

oliver_customer: We'll share example curl calls and a 250-sample prompt file. They want per-request parity for their billing team; i.e., costs reported in requests instead of tokens. Also they have a custom retry behavior on 429 that relies on a Retry-After header in seconds.

sara_security: Heads up: their security questionnaire flags KMS = optional but requires key rotation every 90 days, and they want to know if we store plaintext logs in any intermediate layer. Also SAML SSO is required for admin console access.

leah_sales: Good notes. @tara_legal please prepare an addendum for rotation policy and subprocessor disclosure.

tara_legal: Will do. I'll draft a short addendum that can be attached to the DPA. Ask them if they need a standalone SOC2 attestation or a network summary is fine.

dan_platform: For the shim: we can run a lightweight proxy in front of the Redwood API that rewrites status codes and injects legacy fields (e.g., `body_text`, `trace.hints`). Streaming parity: competitor sends chunked JSON lines with a "done" sentinel; our stream is SSE-based. We can translate SSE -> chunked json lines in the proxy. Estimate 2 engineer-days for a working shim with basic mapping, plus 4 days for rate-limit and retry edgecases.

mike_se: Implementation detail: map our 429 responses to include `Retry-After` header in seconds; ensure the proxy preserves original x-request-id and injects x-compat-mode: "competitor-z" for observability. For billing parity: proxy will increment a per-request meter and expose a small /metrics endpoint for procurement to scrape.

oliver_customer: Do you support returning the exact same error codes for malformed prompts? Their client checks for code 400 + body.error.code == "prompt_invalid".

dan_platform: We can map validation errors to that shape. We need a sample of their error payloads to match fields and codes exactly.

mike_se: For prompt parity: we'll run 300 deterministic prompts (temp=0) and compute similarity using a pairwise token overlap and semantic similarity (embedding cosine). We'll flag any >= 10% divergence for manual review.

leah_sales: Sales / pricing: procurement asked for a short TCO simulation: committed monthly capacity vs their per-request plan. I'll produce a spreadsheet. We can offer a short-term trial with a request-preserving billing shim to make the trial seamless.

sara_security: Two quick security asks for POC: 1) logs retained only in customer-owned S3 if requested; 2) option to disable debugging metadata in responses. Can devs confirm?

dan_platform: Both doable. We already have a log-forwarder; we can flip to S3 target and anonymize debug metadata behind a flag. Need infra to provision temporary S3 and creds.

infra-bot: Reminder: staging namespace reserved for Interchange-POC 2024-06-15 -> 2024-07-01. GPUs: 1xA10 for smoke. Please post teardown requests at least 48 hours in advance.

mike_se: I'll prototype the proxy as an expressjs container that accepts competitor schema and proxies to /v1/generate. Quick mockup: ```js
// pseudo
app.post('/v1/legacy_generate', async (req,res)=>{
  // forward to redwood
  const r = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {body:req.body, headers:{Authorization:process.env.TOKEN}})
  const data = await r.json()
  // map fields
  const legacy = { body_text: data.output, trace:{ hints: data.hints || [] } }
  res.set('Retry-After', r.headers.get('Retry-After') || '0')
  res.status(200).json(legacy)
})
```

leah_sales: Nice. Action items: mike + dan -> build shim POC and demo by Friday; sara -> complete security questionnaire draft; tara -> produce legal addendum; leah -> pricing TCO + trial proposal. Sync tomorrow 10am PT. Anyone hitting blockers ping me or @mike_se. :rocket:
